Registry facts

NoCharge V2 publishes 53 detail routes across Arcade, App Experiences, Tools, and Guides, alongside 48 Articles and 210 Quiet Setup guides. Counts below describe this source inventory, not a quality, accessibility, or performance rating.

Snapshot reviewed November 24, 2026

How the counts are produced

Registry detail routes are derived from the published content registry. Article routes are listed in the imported Article catalog. Quiet Setup detail routes are listed in its source catalog. The production build uses these records to generate static HTML and canonical SEO metadata.

The 334-route total is from the source inventory dated November 16, 2026; the current 328-sitemap total reflects the approved Privacy and Terms indexing flags. The RSS feed at Quiet Setup RSS is generated separately and is not an HTML prerender route.

What these numbers do not say

  • They are not a ranking of quality, difficulty, accessibility, or performance.
  • The 210 Quiet Setup count excludes the /setup/ directory hub; the 48 Articles count excludes the /articles/ hub.
  • Imported article prose can include historical descriptions. A route count does not mean every older product or policy claim remains current.
  • The V2 Privacy, Terms, and Advertising pages describe current site behavior; publisher-draft app policies remain noindex and outside the site-wide policies.
